title: Keep ls holder attribution aligned with its catalog snapshot
outcome: The count and page share a read transaction, but compact holder attribution is fetched after it commits. A concurrent claim change can make a mine-selected row display a different holder snapshot. The current docs promise count plus page only; treat this as consistency hardening, not an existing documentation-contract violation.
acceptance: A deterministic concurrent-claim regression verifies that ls selection and rendered holder use one snapshot, or the separate advisory holder snapshot is explicitly documented and tested.

completion.summary: The counted list reads count, selected page and its live holders in one deferred read transaction. A deterministic second-connection release between count and page still returns the original page and holder; the subsequent listing sees neither. Integrity remains healthy.
